title: Monitoring & Observability — Alert on Symptoms Users Feel
key_insight: Define service-level indicators for availability, latency, and task success. Alert when error budgets burn fast enough to require action.
body:
## Alert on Symptoms Users Feel

A CPU alert fires nightly but users notice nothing; answer failures rise silently with no alert. Infrastructure alone is the wrong signal.

Define service-level indicators for availability, latency, and task success. Alert when error budgets burn fast enough to require action.

Use dashboards for investigation and alerts for action. Every page should have an owner and a clear first response.
common_mistakes: One final error count identifies every root cause.
All user prompts should be logged forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Alert on Symptoms Users Feel” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Observability connects user outcomes to requests, retrieval, models, tools, costs, and failures without exposing sensitive data.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Alert on Symptoms Users Feel” to explain Monitoring & Observability plainly.
